description: Defines a custom price/event alert and returns its current trigger state — armed, fired, or stale — not just the spec. Settlement proof: ProofOfSettledOutcome (kind 30120, data/proof_settled_outcomes.jsonl). Reads off oracle.volatility-monitor and oracle.price-feed; this SKU is the trigger layer, not the data layer. Refuses, with no charge, when live price + buyer threshold fields cannot be fetched. (x402: $0.02 USDC per call)
name: oracle.alert-generator
